method: Uniform sample without replacement from DEV IDs not used in calibration-1 runs. Two sets of 8; draw fixed before API responses. No outcome-based resampling.
acceptance: Compare c02 for each set and aggregate; inspect other-criterion regressions; no promotion on tuning cases alone. New cases are assistant-authored diagnostics, not independent human gold. No edits to candidate after outputs.
limitations: Random DEV subsets may contain translations or related scenarios; they measure regressions, not independent generalization.
All DEV labels were available before this work. The random sets are fresh for API comparison, not a blind benchmark.
A separate 8-case diagnostic set uses new texts and topics, and includes yes/no/na and changes in amount of available information.
One paired run is exploratory; repeat with uncached API calls if apparent improvement needs confirmation.

repeats.reason: Повтор обеих версий на всём новом наборе для оценки вариативности; ответы первого запуска до назначения повтора не разбирались. Оба повтора будут включены в отчёт.

regression_note: Два известных c02-сбоя и 6 случайных ранее просмотренных диалогов; проверка исправлений, не generalization. Не влияет на продвижение без новых наборов.
